caseNameFull: Illinois Central Railroad Company v. C. B. Johnson
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Alabama.
attorneys: Mr. Augustus Benners, Mr. W. S. Horton and Mr. R. V. Fletcher for plaintiff in error. Mr. William Augustus Demon for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
